combobox.name: session_select

button_refresh.script: function onClickRelease(button, x, y) window.session_select.clear() ChatlogExplorer.parseChatLogs() for i, _ in ipairs(ChatlogExplorer.tChatLogs) do window.session_select.add(ChatlogExplorer.tChatLogs[i][1], ChatlogExplorer.tChatLogs[i][1], false) end end
